metaDescription: Order custom 5000 mAh portfolios with built-in power bank. Keep your team charged and branded at events. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Portfolios with a built-in 5000 mAh power bank combine professional organization with on-the-go charging. Ideal for trade shows, sales meetings, and field teams, these portfolios keep documents secure while ensuring phones and tablets stay powered through long days. Choose from styles like the Polypro Filefolio or 2 Pocket Folder, all customizable with your logo via screen printing or embroidery. A practical giveway that attendees will actually use.
heroAltText: Custom 5000 mAh portfolios with built-in power bank, featuring branded logo on front cover and charging cable
